before_entry.다음 행동: CONFIRMED SCOPE, one sentence only: the one_change that section D allows for ROOM_PARTIAL (changing the order or clamp of the fixed end-of-day _drop_inventories_to_shed transfer) cannot make all 16 gated records reach shed_discarded == 0, because engine deposit total = min(carried_total, room) is order-invariant (source) and 44 loss events x 200 random permutations changed the total in 0 cases (data). EXP-012 therefore is not preregistered. This does NOT reject other shed strategies (extra last-turn selling, deposit/sell scheduling, production or harvest throttling, item priority) - none of them were measured by this card. Coin conversion is an ESTIMATE with no verified ceiling: method A (episode-wide average realized price x discarded units) gives 43,977 over the gated 16 records, method B (each item's own realized price) gives 30,886, so A overstates by 29.8 percent because 61.4 percent of the discarded units (70.8 percent in the target record) are WHEAT with base price 25; a strict upper bound is N/A because per-step market inventory and price are not recorded in the artifact. The 12.8-17.6 percent of the 109295 target defeat margin is a static arithmetic scenario, not a causal effect, and the FACTS F-T17 '1 of 50 games' figure is likewise scenario-only. The earlier proposal to prioritise coin attribution of noop_actions is WITHDRAWN: 3488 is a count of unit-turn actions and 482 is a count of items, so their ratio is not a comparison of strategic value, and noop_actions is not a count of engine PASS substitutions (see FACTS F-T22). Next decision input is BOARD P1c - same latest window, defeats and draws linked to actual failures, with causal uncertainty marked. EXP-013 remains separate, unauthorised, and neither supported nor rejected by this card. after_entry.다음 행동: CONFIRMED SCOPE, one sentence only: the one_change that section D allows for ROOM_PARTIAL (changing the order or clamp of the fixed end-of-day _drop_inventories_to_shed transfer) cannot make all 16 gated records reach shed_discarded == 0, because engine deposit total = min(carried_total, room) is order-invariant (source) and 44 loss events x 200 random permutations changed the total in 0 cases (data). EXP-012 therefore is not preregistered. This does NOT reject other shed strategies (extra last-turn selling, deposit/sell scheduling, production or harvest throttling, item priority) - none of them were measured by this card. Coin conversion is an ESTIMATE with no verified ceiling: method A (episode-wide average realized price x discarded units) gives 43,977 over the gated 16 records, method B (each item's own realized price) gives 30,886, so A overstates by 29.8 percent because 61.4 percent of the discarded units (70.8 percent in the target record) are WHEAT with base price 25; a strict upper bound is N/A because per-step market inventory and price are not recorded in the artifact. The 12.8-17.6 percent of the 109295 target defeat margin is a static arithmetic scenario, not a causal effect, and the FACTS F-T17 '1 of 50 games' figure is likewise scenario-only. The earlier proposal to prioritise coin attribution of noop_actions is WITHDRAWN: 3488 is a count of unit-turn actions and 482 is a count of items, so their ratio is not a comparison of strategic value, and noop_actions is not a count of engine PASS substitutions (see FACTS F-T22). Next decision input is BOARD P1c - same latest window, defeats and draws linked to actual failures, with causal uncertainty marked. EXP-013 remains separate, unauthorised, and neither supported nor rejected by this card.
